name: PITS-WORLD-the-lane-gone
note: Past the Bay the abyss is the Bay's pixel id's again: a pit a thousand pixels off a Bay pit shares its abyss.

name: PITS-WORLD-the-Bay's-arm-gone
note: The Bay's pits leave the mod's own GetAbyssMapId.

name: PITS-WORLD-isAbyss-the-Bay's-bound
note: An id of the 0x600 lane whose low 20 bits are no Bay pixel's is taken for a Bay abyss.

name: PITS-WORLD-isAbyss-no-world-lane
note: An abyss past the Bay is not known for one: a lair could be made in it, and its page never opens.

name: PITS-WORLD-isAbyss-any-world-lane
note: A spawned dungeon past the Bay is taken for an abyss.

name: PITS-WORLD-isAbyss-the-old-range
note: Every id from 0x60000000 up an abyss again: a zone hall's and an Abyss Dungeon's.

name: PITS-WORLD-the-hold-the-Bay's
old: export const pitPixelOk = (mapPixelX, mapPixelY) => inWorldGrid(mapPixelX, mapPixelY);
new:
export const pitPixelOk = (mapPixelX, mapPixelY) =>
  mapPixelX >= 0 && mapPixelY >= 0 && mapPixelX < 1000 && mapPixelY < 500;
note: IsValidMapPixel's Bay map again: no pit past the Bay or past the Veil.

name: PITS-WORLD-the-hold-none
note: A pixel off the world's grid is cut, for an abyss no id can name.

name: PITS-WORLD-the-zone's-gate-gone
note: The open zone's water opens a pit.

name: PITS-WORLD-the-zone-offline
old:
if (!isOnlinePage()) return false;
  const m = cyrodiilMask();
note: Offline the authored shape is a zone, and Cyrodiil's water stands no pit for a player alone.

name: PITS-WORLD-the-zone-never
note: Online the zone's water is never asked (the ARENA2 half: the trace's zone).

name: PITS-WORLD-the-lair-reader-the-range
note: A lair's home knows the abyss by the old range.

name: PITS-WORLD-the-page-reader-the-range
note: The tutorial's page knows the abyss by the old range: a zone hall opens the Ocean Holes' page.
